thought: Welcome to Bed-Stuy, I'm on Throop Ave. The minimap has a few markers and an Offer says Crate Digger 15 m. I can't tell yet where home is, so I'll turn right to look at the shopfronts.
The shop has a yellow awning, and the next door is a shuttered grey one, neither says HOME. The brief says N cycles the pointer, so I'll try N to see where it points.
N did nothing, the harness ignores that key, so I'll rely on the minimap and the pointer. The minimap has markers ahead of me, so I'll walk forward along the street and look for a house sign.
